[SWS_CM_80511] Deserializing incomplete data belonging to a field
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00004
⌈
If less data than expected shall be de-serialized and the data to be de-serialized
belong to a
Field
, the
initValue
shall be used if it is defined. Otherwise the data
shall be completely discarded.
⌋
